Advances: specled.package

Orchestrated under epic specled_-233 (2026-07-26), shipping on one PR with specled_-vk0, specled_-gai, specled_-ymn. This ticket blocks specled_-vk0: both edit .spec/specs/package.spec.md.

## Context

From specled_-zhe cold verification (2026-07-25): specled.package.adoption_guide and specled.package.concepts_guide are `must` requirements verified by `kind: source_file`, which verifier.ex satisfies with file existence plus a substring match on the covers marker. Every content clause the requirement statements name could be deleted with spec.check staying green — which is how the N4-N11 doc rot went undetected. The fix is a content-lint test asserting the clauses exist, plus a spec-verification change in .spec/specs/package.spec.md (tagged_tests or command kind replacing/augmenting the source_file stubs). All clauses were verified present as of the specled_-zhe commit.

## Pre-flight correction (orchestrator, 2026-07-26) — the gap is NARROWER than the context above

Releases landed after this ticket was written (specled_-cz0, specled_-0x4) already added command-kind content lint. Verify current state yourself before scoping, but as of base 402f4a27:

- `adoption_guide` ALREADY has mechanical content lint: greenfield/brownfield headings, "Same as greenfield step 6: graduate", the `enforcement:` / `guardrails:` / `branch_guard:` severity-graduation tokens, and both "### Phase 4a — Aggregate coverage (zero wiring)" and "### Phase 4b — Per-test attribution (opt-in)" headings.
- The `mix spec.check` verdict read protocol ALREADY has a command-kind grep asserting the exact protocol sentence in BOTH docs/adoption.md and docs/concepts.md.
- `concepts_guide` is the REAL gap. Its only non-verdict-protocol verification is `kind: source_file, target: docs/concepts.md` — existence-only.

The clauses actually unguarded are all `concepts_guide`'s: the spec triangle (specs <-> code <-> tests), the `realized_by` tiers, the graceful-degrade rule that emits `detector_unavailable` instead of failing when a detector's prerequisites are missing, and all three drift-acceptance paths (durable `mix spec.check --accept-drift`, PR-scoped `Spec-Drift:` trailer, implementation-tier delete-and-reseed ritual).

Do NOT re-assert a clause that already has a passing grep — duplicate coverage is scope creep and will bounce. If you find a named clause is genuinely ABSENT from a doc, that means the requirement statement overclaims: report it in your completion record rather than silently editing the doc to match.

## Allowed touches

- `test/**` — the new content-lint test. A tagged_tests-covered ExUnit module is preferred over more shell greps: it asserts clause presence with readable failure messages and strengthens the existing `kind: tagged_tests` entry.
- `.spec/specs/package.spec.md` — the `spec-verification` block, so `concepts_guide` becomes content-verified rather than existence-verified. Requirement statements ONLY if you find one factually overclaims.
- `docs/concepts.md`, `docs/adoption.md` — ONLY to fix a genuinely-absent clause, and only after saying so in the completion record.
- `.spec/realization_hashes.json` — via its documented regeneration command, if the spec gate demands it.

Co-changing the `Advances:` subject spec above IS authorized: a green `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` outranks a narrow reading of Out of Scope. Do NOT weaken a requirement to make code pass.

## Out of Scope (files)

- `lib/**` — no production change is needed for this ticket.
- `test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs` and the doc-identifier lint corpus/pattern work — that is sibling ticket specled_-vk0, which edits this same spec file after you merge.
- `.spec/specs/*.spec.md` other than package.spec.md.
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `VERSION` — release-time, owned by the epic's PR step.

## Out of Scope (intent)

- No new dependencies in mix.exs.
- No refactor of the existing adoption_guide command entries; leave passing greps alone.
- Do not broaden into general docs QA. Only the clauses the two `must` statements literally name are in scope.

## Verification (gates)

Final tier is change-scoped. Do NOT run the full suite — whole-system proof runs at the orchestrator merge gate and PR CI.

1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix test <your new/edited test files>`
3. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`
4. Execute the specific verification entries you added or flipped to `execute: true`.
5. FALSIFIABILITY GATE — mandatory. Prove the new content lint actually fails when a clause is removed: delete one asserted clause from docs/concepts.md locally, watch the check go red, revert before commit, and state it in your completion record. An existence-only-to-content-lint fix whose new check cannot fail is the exact defect this ticket exists to remove.

Verdict: FAIL

Gaps:
- specled.package.concepts_guide (realized_by-tiers clause): the tiers clause is effectively heading-only verified, so the substance can be deleted with the lint green — the exact defect class this ticket exists to remove. Reproduction: delete docs/concepts.md lines 92-98 (the entire five-tiers table, i.e. the whole explanation of what each tier hashes and catches) and `mix test test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs` still PASSES (1 test, 0 failures; reverted). Cause: of the six needles asserted for that clause (test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs:16-23), only "## The five tiers" is unique to the section. The five tier tokens are satisfied incidentally by unrelated prose elsewhere in the same file — `api_boundary` at docs/concepts.md:129, 262, 580; `implementation` at 129, 536; `expanded_behavior` at 130, 262, 536, 580(region); `typespecs` at 131, 262; `use` at 96-97 prose and elsewhere. So after this change the tiers clause is guarded by one section heading, which is barely stronger than the existence-only source_file check it replaced. Contrast: the triangle clause ("Specs ↔ Code" :50, "Specs ↔ Tests" :55, "Code ↔ Tests" :58), the degrade clause ("**Graceful degrade is first-class.**" :112, "tier silently skips" :115) and all three drift paths (:261, :274, :284) ARE load-bearing — each needle is unique, and I confirmed two of those groups go red. Fix is cheap and stays in the ticket's Allowed touches: assert the row-shaped substance rather than the bare tokens (e.g. "| `api_boundary`        | Function head", "| `typespecs`           | Sorted `@spec`"), or scope the tier search to the text between "## The five tiers" and the next "## " heading.

Notes (advisory only, do not change the verdict):
- Duplicate coverage vs the description's "Do NOT re-assert a clause that already has a passing grep": test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs:37 asserts "spec.check result=" for the verdict protocol, which the existing command-kind entry (.spec/specs/package.spec.md:150-158) already asserts against docs/concepts.md as the full byte-exact protocol sentence. The new assertion is both duplicative and strictly weaker (a 19-char substring vs the whole sentence). Suggest dropping that one assertion in the fix pass rather than a separate ticket.
- docs/concepts.md:3 still carries `<!-- covers: specled.package.concepts_guide -->`, which was the marker the deleted source_file verification matched on. Nothing consumes it now and spec.check does not flag an orphaned covers marker. Harmless, but it is dead provenance metadata; follow-up ticket candidate if the project wants orphan-marker detection.
- test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs is not listed in any subject's `surface:` (neither is its sibling test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs), so the file is unowned for branch-guard surface purposes. Consistent with existing practice; no gate complains.
- The test reads docs/concepts.md via a relative path, so it depends on the ExUnit cwd being the project root. Same pattern as test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs; noted only for completeness.

AUDIT: BOUNCE → implementer

Reasoning: The verifier's Gap is REAL and confirmed by reading, not re-running. Of the six needles asserted for the realized_by-tiers clause at test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs:16-23, only "## The five tiers" (docs/concepts.md:85) is section-unique; every backticked tier token also occurs outside the table at docs/concepts.md:92-98 — `api_boundary` at :129/:262/:263/:580, `implementation` at :106/:129/:130/:154/:287/:329/:536/:581/:582, `expanded_behavior` at :130/:262/:536, `typespecs` at :131/:263, `use` at :263 — so deleting the whole five-tiers table (the entire what-it-hashes / what-it-catches substance the `must` statement at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:108 names) leaves the heading plus all five tokens satisfied and the lint green. That is the exact existence-only-verification defect this ticket exists to remove, and it survives into a `must` requirement, so the FAIL verdict stands and the fix is the implementer's.

The verifier's other findings hold. Its central positive claim — the tagged_tests re-pointing genuinely executes — traces cleanly: .spec/config.yml sets `test_tags.paths: [test]` so test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs:5 `@tag spec: "specled.package.concepts_guide"` lands in the index tag map; TaggedTests.collect_entries/1 (lib/specled_ex/tagged_tests.ex:41) picks up the now-covering execute:true entry at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:120-126; build_command/2 (:82) resolves that cover id through tag_map and appends the file to the merged `mix test` command. Nothing is stranded, and the requirement is better covered than the deleted existence-only source_file entry. The three other clause groups are section-unique as claimed and I confirmed all three by reading (not just the two the verifier executed): triangle needles at :32/:50/:55/:58, degrade at :112 and :115, drift paths at :261/:274/:284 — each a single occurrence inside its own bullet. Mechanical scope re-verified by reading the diff: exactly 2 files (.spec/specs/package.spec.md +1/-4, test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs new/+54), both inside Allowed touches; no lib/**, no docs/**, no realization_hashes.json, no other subject spec, no CHANGELOG/VERSION, and the adoption_guide command entries are byte-identical to base.

On the verifier's Notes: I am OVERTURNING the DUPLICATE-COVERAGE note from advisory to a contract violation and folding it into this bounce — the description states verbatim "Do NOT re-assert a clause that already has a passing grep — duplicate coverage is scope creep and will bounce," and test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs:37 re-asserts "spec.check result=" which .spec/specs/package.spec.md:152-160 already greps byte-exact against docs/concepts.md for this same requirement. An explicit ticket prohibition being violated is a deliverable contradiction, not an advisory; the verifier should have filed it under Gaps. That is a downgrade error, but it does not change the route: the verdict was already FAIL, the item was disclosed with the correct fix, and both corrections land in the same test/** pass. I am UPHOLDING the ORPHANED-MARKER note as genuinely advisory: docs/adoption.md:3 already carries `<!-- covers: specled.package.adoption_guide -->` with no source_file entry at base (confirmed against 402f4a27), so concepts.md:3 now matches pre-existing project practice rather than introducing dead metadata. Third note (surface: ownership) is correct and consistent with its sibling.

Bounce reason: Two corrections, both confined to test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs (no spec, doc, or lib change needed).

1. Make the realized_by-tiers assertion load-bearing. The five bare backticked tier tokens at :17-:23 are satisfied by unrelated prose elsewhere in docs/concepts.md, so the clause is guarded by its heading alone. Either assert the row-shaped substance (e.g. "| `api_boundary`        | Function head", "| `typespecs`           | Sorted `@spec`") or scope the tier search to the slice between "## The five tiers" and the next "## " heading. Then re-run the FALSIFIABILITY GATE against THIS clause specifically: delete docs/concepts.md:92-98 (the table), show `mix test test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs` goes RED, revert before commit, and state that exact mutation in the completion record. The prior falsifiability demonstration used the drift-path clause, which was already load-bearing, so it did not exercise the weak assertion.

2. Drop the duplicate verdict-protocol assertion at test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs:37 (and its now-unused `assert_contains/3` helper at :50-:53 if nothing else uses it). The clause already has a passing byte-exact grep for concepts_guide at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:152-160; the new assertion is a strictly weaker 19-char substring of it and the description forbids re-asserting it.

Optional, not blocking: the triangle group's needles are the bold bullet labels only, so the ASCII triangle diagram at docs/concepts.md:37-48 is unguarded. Section-scoping that group too would close the same class of hole, but each existing needle is section-unique so the clause is not heading-only and I am not requiring it.
